title: Control document
description: The envelope of a control document (SYN-060, REL-060, REL-070, ADR-0077): signed by the online control role that the root delegates to. The document member is the FlatBuffers buffer of schema/control.fbs, which a device reads only after the signature, the expiry and the version have been checked (SEC-052). The header repeats the fields the device checks first; the FlatBuffers document must agree with it.

version.description: Strictly increasing per app, environment and channel; a device refuses a lower one (PLX-3102).

expires.description: After this instant the document is expired (PLX-3101) and only the kill switches it last carried stay in force.

document.description: The FlatBuffers ControlDocument of schema/control.fbs, file identifier PLXC.
